certification.name: Open-Source Certified
certification.description: Vendor-neutral OSINT practitioner certification from the OSMOSIS Association with a proctored exam of 100 multiple-choice and true/false questions. Applicants document 75 hours of related experience in the previous year and sign an ethics statement; renewal needs 45 CPEs in three years.
certification.currency_note: Virtual proctored exam; an older OSMOSIS FAQ quotes $200 and a $150 annual maintenance fee, not confirmed on the current pages
